description: This is a unit test class for the ImmutableLogEntry class in the org.eclipse.ditto.model.connectivity package. It contains test cases verifying object creation, JSON serialization/deserialization, immutability, and equality checks for the ImmutableLogEntry model used within the project.

classes.name: ImmutableLogEntryTest
classes.description: Unit test class for ImmutableLogEntry, testing creation, JSON conversion, immutability, and equality.

methods.name: createInstanceWithNullCorrelationId
methods.description: Tests that creating a LogEntry with null correlation ID throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: createInstanceWithNullTimestamp
methods.description: Tests that creating a LogEntry with null timestamp throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: createInstanceWithNullLogCategory
methods.description: Tests that creating a LogEntry with null log category throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: createInstanceWithNullLogType
methods.description: Tests that creating a LogEntry with null log type throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: createInstanceWithNullMessage
methods.description: Tests that creating a LogEntry with null message throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: createInstanceWithNullLogLevel
methods.description: Tests that creating a LogEntry with null log level throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: createInstanceWithNullAddress
methods.description: Verifies that setting null address results in an empty address in the LogEntry.

methods.name: createInstanceWithNullThingId
methods.description: Verifies that setting null ThingId results in an empty thingId in the LogEntry.

methods.name: logEntryWithMissingThingIdAndAddress
methods.description: Checks that LogEntry with null address and thingId serializes to JSON with empty fields.

methods.name: jsonWithMissingThingIdAndAddress
methods.description: Checks that JSON missing thingId and address deserializes to LogEntry with empty fields.

methods.name: verifyBuilder
methods.description: Verifies that the builder constructs an identical LogEntry object.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Ensures toJson produces expected JSON output.

methods.name: fromJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks that fromJson reconstructs the correct LogEntry object.

methods.name: fromJsonWithIllegalDate
methods.description: Ensures that invalid date format in JSON throws JsonParseException.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies proper implementation of equals and hashCode.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Checks beyond simple mutability assertions that objects are truly immutable.
